storage.built_in: OS on 2 x M.2 SSDs (RAID 1); recording HDDs by model: 84 TB (7 x 12 TB), 112 TB (7 x 16 TB), 160 TB (8 x 20 TB)

features: Preloaded Video Insight software with VI Enterprise Server activation
Recommended recording rate: 300-600 Mbps on a 1 Gbps network, 600-1000 Mbps on a 10 Gbps network
Network: 2 x 1 GbE BASE-T and 2 x 10 GbE SFP+
notes: Datasheet lists a 2U rack mount with 1U dimensions (H 1.69 in, W 18.9 in, D 23.58 in); dimensions left out.
